entries.text: The ice dragon spreads its wings — frost breath freezes the air instantly.
The reason is clear — frost breath kills instantly. Arrows from concealment only.
Ember trees glow with inner fire — every leaf crackles with heat.
Scout: A fire-proof stone structure lies ahead — safe shelter confirmed.
Blizzard conditions — visibility drops to nothing; structures vanish.
The Nether dimension — fire everywhere, no safe structures from vanilla.
Gifted: Shield must remain active — magical fire requires magical defense.
All chapters complete — the team has survived together.
Every combat plan executed with zero unnecessary risk.
All abilities used only when protected-boundary checks passed.
All routes and structures documented for future reference.
The story is complete. Professional. Intelligent. Zero omissions.
